preconditions.description: Attacker must hold honeyToken tokens to trigger transfer fees

exploit_hint: Execute multiple token transfers to trigger the charity fee mechanism. The _reflectFee function only reduces _tTotal by tBurn but not by tCharity, causing total supply accounting inconsistency. Monitor the FeeAddress balance accumulation versus _tTotal reduction to verify the accounting error. This creates token inflation where charity fees are collected but not properly removed from total supply, potentially diluting token value.
